bug_policy: IMPLEMENTATION_BUG_FIX logged, preregistration preserved, affected results re-run and decision fields compared; a fix that changes the experiment definition => PREDECLARATION_INVALIDATED (stop)

calibration.weight: random delay 0.048 ns per normal point in every case (no systematic term in the weight)

CALIBRATION.CALIBRATION_FRAGILE: exists only for C1_HALF and/or C0, or no window at C1_NOMINAL while C0/C1_HALF has one
CALIBRATION.CALIBRATION_ROBUST: canonical HF window (>= 7 pts, overlapping) survives C1_DOUBLE
CALIBRATION.NO_WINDOW_ANY_CALIBRATION: no canonical HF window under any case

FIDELITY.FIDELITY_CHANGES_EXISTENCE: exactly one of SIMPLIFIED / HIGH_FIDELITY has a window
FIDELITY.FIDELITY_SHIFTS_WINDOW: both have a window, a boundary moves > 5 deg
FIDELITY.FIDELITY_STABLE: existence unchanged (both or neither) and, if both, each boundary moves <= 5 deg

MECHANISM.LATER_SESSIONS_DILUTE_DIRECTION: median d_diff < -0.01 AND median ikk_ratio > 1.1 AND median added_orth_frac < median first_orth_frac
MECHANISM.quantities: per canonical HF phase where ALL has > 1 session: d_diff = delta_ALL - delta_FIRST (C1 nominal); ikk_ratio = I_kk(ALL) / I_kk(FIRST); added_orth_frac = (I_perp(ALL) - I_perp(FIRST)) / (I_kk(ALL) - I_kk(FIRST)) where I_perp = conditional K information; first_orth_frac = f_perp(FIRST)^2

confirmatory_success: 1 canonical HF C1_NOMINAL FIRST has a >= 7-point (30 deg) STRONG window
3 >= 4 of the 5 orbits (CANON included) have an overlapping >= 7-point STRONG window (HF, C1_NOMINAL)
4 every normal point of every counted window cell is contract-valid (visibility, occultation, coverage, events)
5 the canonical window is not created solely by C0_IDEAL (C1_NOMINAL window exists by 1)
6 independent design reconstruction reproduces the metrics (max |f_perp difference| <= 1e-10)
7 no primary rule changed after inspection (predeclaration hash unchanged)

decision_tree.B: GM_WINDOW_EXISTS_BUT_IS_ORBIT_GEOMETRY_DEPENDENT: R0 true (canonical HF C1 window) but < 4/5 orbits
decision_tree.C: GM_WINDOW_IS_DYNAMICS_FIDELITY_FRAGILE: canonical SIMPLIFIED and HIGH_FIDELITY disagree on window existence (C1_NOMINAL, FIRST)
decision_tree.D: GM_WINDOW_IS_CALIBRATION_FRAGILE: canonical HF has no C1_NOMINAL window but has one under C0_IDEAL or C1_HALF
decision_tree.E: D3_SECONDARY_GM_WINDOW_DOES_NOT_CONFIRM: otherwise (no canonical HF C1_NOMINAL window)
decision_tree.nonlinear_confirmation: YES only for A (narrowly, GM design only); NO otherwise

dynamics.HIGH_FIDELITY: examples/phase17_r1od2_fidelity.propagate_fidelity: GL1800F 50x50 MOON_PA_DE440 + Earth and Sun point-mass third body (SPICE) + production SRP (conical penumbra), harmonic STM opt-in, F1-qualified variational equations, rtol 1e-12 (the D3 Stage C configuration)
dynamics.SIMPLIFIED: phase17_r1od2_core.propagate_nom48 (Moon point mass + lunar J2 + SRP), controlled comparison
dynamics.fallback_only_if_full_matrix_fails_to_co: HF on all 22 CANON phases plus all 5 orbits at 75/90/105/135/150 deg and the two nearest 5-deg shoulder points on each side of each D3 cluster (65, 70, 110, 115, 125, 130, 155, 160)
dynamics.matrix: FULL: both dynamics for every orbit x phase cell (5 x 22 x 2 = 220 geometries); feasibility measured before this file: one HF propagation ~257 s, 110 HF over 15 workers ~30 min

forbidden: rank(H^T W H) as an observability gate
hypothesis_source: D3 secondary observation (docs/phase17_r1od3_tracking_design_characterization.md s22): GM FIRST_SESSION STRONG at D3 k = 5, 6, 7 (75/90/105 deg), C1 nominal, simplified dynamics; exploratory, 1 of 13 patterns (multiple-comparison exposed)
independent_verification: F independent lstsq reconstruction of range + DDOR + bias + prior + whitening for every primary cell
G D3 anchor reproduction at 75/90/105/135/150 (canonical SIMPLIFIED, FIRST and ALL, all five calibrations) vs artifacts/phase17_r1od3_primary_results.csv to 1e-12

literature.evidence: DSN 810-005 index lists 210F (CL 26-2234, as read by D3), 107F (CL 25-3456); 107F PDF sha256 3a8da003e866ce1169164e5d1f733055923af208062acb19b696847fb2fc1d1d identical to D3; CCSDS 500.1-G-2 retained
literature.prior_status: REPOSITORY arithmetic from DSN-210F Table 8 systematic rows; not a DSN Gaussian claim

literature_overlay.dsn_good_gm_geometry: Sun-Earth-spacecraft > 10 deg AND declination > -15 deg (LITERATURE_RESULT context, not a validity rule)
per_phase: spacecraft geocentric declination at FIRST midpoint

mechanism_quantities: session midpoint geometry (geocentric spacecraft declination, Sun-Earth-spacecraft angle)
session DDOR-only f_perp (dense rows inside the session interval)

CANON.source: campaign epoch + campaign x0 (FXR canonical, GEO G0_consistent)

phase_grid.epoch_convention: et0 = 857806356.99998 + (phase_deg / 15) * synodic_month_s / 24, synodic_month_s = 2551442.8896 (identical to D3 k * S / 24 at phase = 15 k; D3 grid a651c4de)
phase_grid.held_invariant: same J2000/LME state vector per orbit, 15 canonical orbits, 90 s grid, K = 0.01

schedules.primary: FIRST_SESSION (earliest qualifying GM window, chronological only)
schedules.session_abstraction: D3 exactly: contiguous dual-visibility window >= 20 min; session <= 60 min centred; 3 normal points at 1/6, 1/2, 5/6 of the session rows (phase17_r1od3_core.build_sessions)

source_overlay.criterion: a source within 0.1 rad of the geocentric spacecraft direction at every FIRST_SESSION midpoint

tests.R0_canonical: GM FIRST_SESSION, CANON, HIGH_FIDELITY, C1_NOMINAL: >= 7-point STRONG window overlapping [75,150]
tests.R1_orbit: same criterion per orbit (HIGH_FIDELITY, C1_NOMINAL, FIRST_SESSION); report start, end, width, days, max and median delta inside the window
tests.R2_calibration: for each canonical HF window found under C1_NOMINAL (or, if none, report the C0/C1_HALF windows): recompute the window under all five cases; persist / shrink / fragment / disappear
tests.R3_fidelity: canonical SIMPLIFIED vs HIGH_FIDELITY (C1_NOMINAL, FIRST): existence, boundaries, class changes

thresholds.delta_definition: f_perp(range + DDOR) - f_perp(range), same orbit / epoch / dynamics range baseline

window.equivalence: D3: >= 3 consecutive points on a 15-deg grid = 30 deg endpoint span; D4 5-deg grid: >= 7 consecutive STRONG points = 30 deg endpoint span (3 points on a 5-deg grid do NOT qualify)
window.invalid_cells: a phase with no qualifying GM session (FIRST infeasible) is NOT STRONG
window.overlap_rule: a window overlaps the D3 candidate region if [start, end] intersects [75, 150]
